The tires are thin, typical of road bikes.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a clean, well-maintained road bike with no visible damage or wear.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Internal chain or drivetrain issues (e.g., worn chain, damaged cassette, or broken derailleur)
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo of the chain, cassette, and derailleur in motion, or a photo of the chain length and cassette condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially needing repair or replacement parts

risks.risk: Brakes not functioning properly (e.g., worn pads, seized calipers, or brake cable issues)
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the brake pads and rotors, and a video showing the brakes being applied and released.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially needing brake repairs

risks.risk: Tires are worn or flat (not visible in photo)
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the tire tread and sidewalls, and a video showing the tires inflated and rolling.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially needing tire replacement

risks.risk: Frame or components have hidden cracks or rust (not visible in photo)
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the frame joints, welds, and bottom bracket area, and a video showing the frame being tapped or inspected for cracks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially needing frame repair or replacement

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the chain, cassette, and derailleur in motion.
Close-up photo of the brake pads and rotors.
Close-up photo of the tire tread and sidewalls.
Close-up photo of the frame joints and bottom bracket area.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
